programme.title: Our Big Blue Backyard
programme.desc: Te Moananui a Toi/ The Hauraki Gulf lies on the doorstep of New Zealand's largest city. Every summer millions of visitors from the tropics converge here, all lured by a unique seasonal smorgasbord. Giant oceanic manta rays, rarely filmed in these waters, glide into the gulf. Bryde's whales are also primed for the feasting season, alongside common dolphins, and bronze whaler sharks. In the sky above rare black petrels stalk the dolphins to survive.
programme.sub-title: Te Moananui a Toi/ The Hauraki Gulf

programme.title: Destination Wild - Wild Islands
programme.desc: The Caribbean has been shaped by millions of years of unstoppable volcanic forces and ferocious hurricanes, creating a network of 7,000 islands, each one more unique than the next. From islets only a few miles long to landmasses with towering peaks, the habitats of this tropical paradise range from lush rainforests hiding untold species to multi-coloured coral reefs teeming with marine life.

programme.title: Hidden UK
programme.desc: For its tiny size the UK is a hugely varied landscape with a surprising collection of remarkable and awe-inspiring wildlife.

programme.title: Destination Wild: Wild Madagascar
programme.desc: Millions of years ago, hundreds of castaway creatures crash-landed on Madagascar's rugged shores. Isolated from the mainland, evolution went into overdrive. Of almost a quarter of a million species found on the island are unique. This myriad of bizarre life forms had a huge impact on the early human settlers - one particular group of primates shaped their culture, fuelling folklore and legend that still guides their lives today. Limited Rights Available: Worldwide, Free TV Only

programme.title: Aging in the Wild
programme.desc: Salmon, Bears, Beluga Whales, Naked Mole Rat, Bacteria, Aspen Trees In this episode, we explore how different animal species react to impending death. We explore the factors that lead animals to their final resting places: disease, injury, predation, drought, famine. Some species, such as the naked mole rat, while not immortal, seem to be able to effectively protect themselves from certain diseases such as cancer.

programme.title: Hawaii: Paradise in the Pacific
programme.desc: In epsiode one we take a look at Kaua'i - the oldest island in the archipelago. Kaua'i's isolation for thousands of years led to an increased rate of evolution. In a relatively short time, new species are formed here, many animals and plants can only be found here. But they are in danger. On the shield volcano Waiʻaleʻale - the rainiest place on earth, scientists like Lukas Behnke are fighting for the preservation of endangered native animals and plants.

programme.title: Wildest Places: Antarctic
programme.desc: Wildest Places explores some of the most incredible natural habitats on earth & a diverse range of wildlife.

programme.title: World of the Wild
programme.desc: The Arctic is alive with a fascinating assortment of wildlife and species that are unique to this Polar environment. Most of are rarely or never seen outside the Arctic Circle. They live and thrive in a hostile environment of ice, polar desert, wind-swept open tundra, ancient glacial formations, sub zero sea temperatures and an incredible variety of geographical topo-graphy from open plain and valleys to mountainous peaks and deep water fiords.

programme.title: Heroes of the Wild Frontiers
programme.desc: What seems calm and tranquil may not necessarily be so. Under the tranquility there maybe a vibrant dynamic world and above water there maybe dangers which are lurking at very corner. Mahatma Gandhi Marine National Park is one such. In the Andaman Islands a group of 15 islands make up this fragile eco system. Coral, is one of the most productive and endangered wild fauna in the shallow coastal waters.

programme.title: Mountains - Gateways to Heaven
programme.desc: Mountains define our most spectacular landscapes. As they climb the changing altitude results in a mosaic of dramatic habitats, teaming with incredible wildlife. They're found on every continent on Earth, literally from pole to pole, covering 22% of the planet's surface. An incredibly important part of our ecosystem, a quarter of terrestrial animal and plant species, live in mountains and they house an incredible 85% of all amphibians, mammals and birds.

programme.title: World's Wildest City: Anchorage
programme.desc: For years, at least four highly elusive wolfpacks have lived and hunted on the edge of the wild city of Anchorage. But as the city spreads further and further into wolf country, the wolves are now getting bolder, and attacks on humans are on the increase. A group was recently targeted whilst jogging with their dog on a trail near one of the city's main roads.

programme.title: Sexy Beasts
programme.desc: Driven by surging hormones, every creature on the planet, big or small, will do whatever it takes to find and secure a mate. For some this will take the fight of their lives, while others must preen, prance and party their way to success. From one night stands and group sex to lifelong love and unbreakable bonds, when it comes to finding a mate the animal kingdom has it all. The need to breed manifests itself in all sorts of wonderful antics, displays and behaviours.

programme.title: Owls - Masters of the Night
programme.desc: Owls are mysterious creatures, living in a twilight world that we can rarely visit. Many cultures, including the Romans, Mayans and Aztecs, saw owls as something to fear, symbols of bad luck and impending doom. In reality owls are highly resourceful birds that have carved out a niche and a unique way to live. They range in size from smaller than a pigeon to as large as an eagle. They've colonised terrains from tundra to rainforest.

programme.title: Hidden Australia
programme.desc: Sometimes called the biggest island on Earth, Australia is a subcontinent of incredible diversity, beauty, danger and downright weirdness.

programme.title: Migrations - Herds on the Move
programme.desc: Whether driven by the search for food or the simple will to survive, great herd migrations are some of the most spectacular events of the natural world.

programme.title: Destination Wild - Wild Europe
programme.desc: Europe was once covered by forest, from the Arctic Ocean to the Mediterranean Sea. Wiped out in a mini ice age around 15000 years ago, they, and the wildlife that inhabit them are making a spectacular recovery. Today, Europe's forests cover around 1 000 million hectares (about 30 times the size of Poland).

programme.title: Fight for Territory
programme.desc: Biological instinct is driven by three things: the desire to stay alive, to find food and to breed. But to do all these things, animals first need a home. Out in the wilderness a safe place to call home can be the difference between life and death. A place to secure meals, raise their families and hide from danger. Ideal spots are in short supply and well worth fighting for!

programme.title: February (Nature's Calendar)
programme.desc: In the northern hemisphere February is one of the toughest months of the year, the seemingly unending cold and scarce food of winter. Some animals fail, but their bodies become a bounty that will see carnivores and scavengers through. In parts of Africa animals face the opposite problem, high temperatures and overdue rains and must trek to find food and water. While the Amazon has the opposite problem, too much water, with the rainforest wildlife having to adapt to a submerged forest.

programme.title: Creepy Crawlies - Army
programme.desc: Few creatures have the complex levels of regimented society as the social insects; these creatures understand that the strength of the individual is nothing compared with the combined power of the group. Creepy crawlies can form armies to help them build elaborate homes, raise their young and hunt their prey. These incredible communities both plagues our nightmares and fuels our imaginations. Society is considered the realm of higher beings, but hidden amongst the foliage, an army is rising.

programme.title: Destination Wild - Wild Europe
programme.desc: Over the last million years, our planet suffered a series of major ice-ages. Much of the northern hemisphere was covered in ice sheets several kilometres thick and creatures had no choice but to adapt or die. Over time, temperatures rose, causing these glaciers to retreat, however, in certain parts of Europe the ice-age never left. For many creatures, the struggle to survive 'a life below zero' continues.

programme.title: Polar Bear Family
programme.desc: We have a complex relationship with polar bears. One of the most loved creatures in the world, we see them as cute and funny but at the same time as dangerous top predators. One of the few that might actually hunt us. They are the ultimate icons of polar wilderness and have become figureheads for climate change and conservation. One thing is for sure, the lives of polar bears are nothing short of remarkable.

programme.title: Meet the Marsupials
programme.desc: Few countries have a more iconic representative in the animal kingdom than Australia and the marsupial. Once marsupials were found across the planet, but over time they found their way to the outback, leaving Australia as an ark carrying the future of pouch mammals. As varied as they are unusual, marsupials are a weird and wonderful mob of animals who carry their young in a pouch.

programme.title: Destination Wild - Wild Argentina
programme.desc: Stretching almost 1000 miles, from the jungles of Brazil to the southernmost point of South America, Patagonia's coast is home to some of the natural world's most spectacular animals. Here, a parched desert collides with a powerful ocean, but right along this extreme and hostile coastline, animals battle the elements and each other, in a fight for survival.

programme.title: Hidden Australia
programme.desc: Sometimes called the biggest island on Earth, Australia is a subcontinent of incredible diversity, beauty, danger and downright weirdness.

programme.title: The Enchanted Forest
programme.desc: To spend a day in the forest, from dawn to dusk, is to bathe in nature. There's enchantment at every turn. Throughout the day the cast of characters in the forest changes, from foraging bears to playing fox cubs, dashing hummingbirds and dancing butterflies. But it's as twilight descends, that the most enchanting side of the forest is revealed. Time to watch a firework display curtesy of fireflies. They are the real magicians of the enchanted forest.

programme.title: Destination Wild - Wild Europe
programme.desc: The story of Europe's living waters begins at great altitude. Melt waters from the highest snow-capped peaks feed some of the greatest rivers. On their relentless downward journey, streams and rivers have carved through all of Europe's greatest landscapes. Gorges, lakes and wetlands are home to an incredible array of wildlife and seas and oceans have sculpted a coastline of endless variety.

programme.title: Mountains - Gateways to Heaven
programme.desc: Mountains define our most spectacular landscapes. As they climb the changing altitude results in a mosaic of dramatic habitats, teaming with incredible wildlife. They're found on every continent on Earth, literally from pole to pole, covering 22% of the planet's surface. An incredibly important part of our ecosystem, a quarter of terrestrial animal and plant species, live in mountains and they house an incredible 85% of all amphibians, mammals and birds.

programme.title: Wildest Survival
programme.desc: In this episode we explore why and how animals fight and reveal the ways in which they are programmed to survive at all costs. Most animals will defend themselves against predators, but many also do battle with members of the same species. Animals fight for two main reasons: for a mate or to defend their young or territory. And when animals fight, it can often be to the death.

programme.title: The Power Of Plants - Race to Grow and Breed
programme.desc: Just like animals, the lives of plants are dominated by the need to become strong and pass on genes to the next generation - a race to grow and breed. They must race to beat their competition to the best light spots, and to make the most of perilously short seasons. And also like in the animal kingdom, different species have developed a near unending list of strategies to ensure their legacy is passed on.

programme.title: Sexy Beasts
programme.desc: Driven by surging hormones, every creature on the planet, big or small, will do whatever it takes to find and secure a mate. For some this will take the fight of their lives, while others must preen, prance and party their way to success. From one night stands and group sex to lifelong love and unbreakable bonds, when it comes to finding a mate the animal kingdom has it all. The need to breed manifests itself in all sorts of wonderful antics, displays and behaviours.

programme.title: History of Life on Earth - Mammal Takeover
programme.desc: With the dinosaurs' passing, a land of opportunity was laid bare for the little mammals that had scampered about their feet.

programme.title: World's Wildest City: Anchorage
programme.desc: There are more Caribou in Alaska than people! Across the Arctic, they're the lifeblood of many remote communities. But human expansion, and wild predators, have led to their rapid decline. Out on the tundra, Caribou are the prey of choice for Alaska's carnivores, and at a ranch on the edge of Anchorage, the reindeer are at constant risk from the area's wolves and brown bears. The people of Anchorage have vowed to protect them, but will their help be enough for the Caribou to survive?

programme.title: World's Wildest City: Anchorage
programme.desc: One of Alaska's most secretive and efficient predators, Lynx are usually highly elusive... but in Anchorage, houses are being built in the Lynx's territory, forcing these usually shy big cats, to find new ways to survive on the streets. programme.title: Hauntings
programme.desc: In 1958, two young women traveled together in a Ford Sedan to a nightclub in Georgia, on the other side of Lake Lanier. But they never returned. Weeks later reports began of a ghostly figure: a lady wearing a blue dress, walking across the lake, whilst calls for help were heard from the waters below. Then stories of unexplained drownings emerged.

programme.title: The Past Hunters: Enter the Paranormal
programme.desc: Ordsall Hall is over 820 years old. It has been put to many uses including a family home, working men's club and church hall. With over 15 hauntings and many sightings, Ordsall Hall will certainly keep the team busy.

programme.title: Ghost Dimension Flying Solo
programme.desc: Sean heads to Oswestry to investigate claims of hauntings at a castle which is 1000's of years old. Believed to be haunted by an angry judge. Will any of the souls departed here, come out to play?
programme.sub-title: Historic Hauntings of Whittington Castle - Part 1

programme.title: Hauntings
programme.desc: When Andrea Perron moved into her new home in Rhode Island with her parents and four sisters, the previous occupants seemed in a hurry to leave. 'For the sake of your family, leave the lights on in this house at night,' they told her father, Roger. Soon the Perrons were experiencing multiple disturbances, hearing whispers and seeing visions.

programme.title: Ghost Dimension Flying Solo
programme.desc: Sean continues his investigation of the castle and attempts to make contact with the spirit world. It appears he is not alone on his investigation.
programme.sub-title: Historic Hauntings of Whittington Castle - Part 2

programme.title: A Haunting
programme.desc: Edwin Gonzalez and Lillian Otero move into a dream Victorian home, but eerie footsteps and slamming doors soon plague them. When Edwin sees a full-body apparition, they seek help. Lillian's behavior darkens as an evil female spirit possesses her. She suffers physical attacks in her sleep, and as the hauntings escalate, they realize escaping may no longer be an option.

programme.title: Ghost Dimension
programme.desc: The team head to Lydiate Abbey to investigate claims of a ghostly white lady and stumble upon a totally hidden gem deep in the woods, which has its own spirits haunting. With hidden priest holes and a building being reclaimed by the land. Be prepared for one of the scariest investigations ever.

programme.title: C.O.R.N: A Field of Screams
programme.desc: Stranded in a rural area, 2 teens make friends with locals on Halloween but soon run into a cult called C.O.R.N. (Collective Order of Recreational Necrophilanthropists) that have chosen this area to perform human taxidermy.

programme.title: Ghost Dimension Lockdown
programme.desc: Bex and Sean investigate Chillingham Castle, the most haunted castle in the world, for a Halloween investigation.

programme.title: Ghost Dimension
programme.desc: The team head to Elland to investigate ghostly goings on in this haunted pub. Its not just the spirits behind the bar lurking here. Multiple hauntings, murders and death surround this public house. Will headless horses make an appearance tonight and who or what haunts the beer cellar?
programme.sub-title: Last Orders at The Fleece Inn

programme.title: Historic Hauntings
programme.desc: Deep in Wales' long memory is a history of violence and bloody curses. Where the deeds of noblemen and warrior princes come back to haunt the living world. Acts of treachery and vengeance leave their stain within Wales' haunted castles.

programme.title: Ghost Dimension
programme.desc: Bex and Sean explore Gwrych Castle in Wales, renowned for its hauntings. Amid eerie voices, strange noises, and shadows, they use specialized equipment to unveil the spectral mysteries lurking within. Will they unearth Gwrych Castle's ghostly secrets?

programme.title: Historic Hauntings
programme.desc: Explore Bishop's Palace in London, haunted by the Royal Executioner Bishop Bonner's victims from over 500 years ago. Discover evidence and tales of hauntings marking the Palace's dark history. In Rye, Sussex, encounter the ghost of a Queen Elizabeth handmaiden, forever searching for a lost pearl necklace, driven to suicide by shame.

programme.title: Hauntings
programme.desc: On the night of Christmas 1998, a homeless man entered the infamous Greyfriars Kirkyard in Edinburgh. Seeking refuge, he broke into the tomb of George Mackenzie - Edinburgh's famous executioner - then fell into an assembly of decomposing corpses. His screams were heard above ground, but something else had been disturbed. Within weeks, stories of blackouts and inexplicable attacks began to spread.

programme.title: Hauntings
programme.desc: In September 1977 police attended a house in Enfield, London, to investigate a reported home invasion: there had been loud knocking on the wall and furniture moved. The two officers could find no evidence of a break in, but they did hear various rapping on the walls, see furniture tilt independently and a chair slide several metres across the room on its own.

programme.desc: Immersed in Ireland's timeless beauty is a dark history of magic, ritual and prime evil worship. Elemental forces from this ancient past come back as apparitions to wander amongst the living and many of these restless souls are trapped in Ireland's castles. The spirits reach out from the beyond, lost phantoms that have become the castle ghosts of Ireland.

programme.title: Ghost Dimension
programme.desc: This abandoned World War Two air raid shelter holds paranormal secrets that haunt anyone that ventures inside. A menacing ghostly entity makes contact as the team try to uncover the reasons behind the hauntings.

programme.title: Historic Hauntings

programme.title: Hauntings
programme.desc: On the night of Christmas 1998, a homeless man entered the infamous Greyfriars Kirkyard in Edinburgh. Seeking refuge, he broke into the tomb of George Mackenzie - Edinburgh's famous executioner - then fell into an assembly of decomposing corpses. His screams were heard above ground, but something else had been disturbed. Within weeks, stories of blackouts and inexplicable attacks began to spread.

programme.title: Ghost Dimension Lockdown
programme.desc: Bex and Sean head to New Mills and investigate a home situated on the grounds of death and destruction from the bombings of WWII.

programme.title: Historic Hauntings
programme.desc: Explore King Charles I's eerie legacy at Carisbrooke and Windsor Castles, where paranormal events unfold. Encounter Herne the Hunter's ghost at Windsor's Great Park. Witness a ghost ship off the Isle of Wight and stroll Betty Haunt Lane. In Canterbury, discover a servant girl's lingering spirit and the mysterious memorial to a murdered holy man.

programme.title: Historic Hauntings
programme.desc: England's history has been steeped in ambition, greed, treachery and betrayal. Its castle walls have witnessed centuries of bloodshed. The anguished wales of the forlorn still echo through the corridors. Cut off by tragic death these restless spirits have been trapped in limbo between heaven and hell. This program presents spine tingling stories in a riveting tour of England's ghostly heritage.

programme.title: Historic Hauntings
programme.desc: Explore the Palace of Hampton Court, Britain's most haunted site. programme.title: A Haunting
programme.desc: A Halloween dare leads high school friends Nick, Krystian, and Jon to an old cemetery in Green Lake, Wisconsin. Seeking a rumored haunted mausoleum, they become separated in the darkness. As they sense an eerie presence stalking them, their skepticism turns to terror. They must escape before the vengeful spirits of the graveyard awaken-and ensure they never leave.

programme.title: Ghost Dimension
programme.desc: Join Bex, Sean and the team as they investigate The Wellington Hotel for Halloween. Based in Halewood, this public inn has more haunting inside of its walls than the spirits behind the bar.

programme.title: Hauntings

Weeks later reports began of a ghostly figure: a lady wearing a blue dress, walking across the lake, whilst calls for help were heard from the waters below. Then stories of unexplained drownings emerged.

programme.title: Murder Maps
programme.desc: In 1911, a gun battle on the streets of London, The Siege of Sidney Street, is the first breaking-news story in history.

programme.title: Mind Investigators
programme.desc: On September 2nd 2015, the body of 2 years-old Méline is found in her home. Her father confesses to the murder.

programme.title: The Interrogation Room Hosted by Vivica A. Fox
programme.desc: Linda Riley was reported missing when a neighbor couldn't contact her and signs of a struggle were discovered in her home. The race is on to try and find Linda safe and well.

programme.title: Crimes Uncovered
programme.desc: Six-month-old Jordan Leigh Norton is fatally wounded during a supposed house burglary, it is then uncovered that baby Jordan was a victim caught in the fatal cross-fire of a violent love triangle.
programme.sub-title: Too Young to Die: The Jordan- Leigh Norton Story

programme.title: Becoming Evil: Secret Language of Serial Killers
programme.desc: Talk about body language. See how serial killers like the Night Stalker use their victims as just another way to get their message out to the world.

programme.title: Caught on Bodycam
programme.desc: Raw bodycam footage capturing high-stake police incidents.

programme.title: Caught on Bodycam
programme.desc: Raw bodycam footage capturing high-stake police incidents.

programme.title: Nurses Who Kill
programme.desc: Nurse Roger Dean said he loved the residents at the care home where he worked just outside Sydney, Australia, but loved the drugs he was addicted to more. Unfortunately, he strongly suspected that he had been caught on camera stealing them. He set the place on fire and killed 10 people. Mark Tedeschi reveals the evidence he took to court to win a conviction against Nurse Dean.

programme.title: Nurses Who Kill
programme.desc: Anne Grigg-Booth, who was responsible for administering painkilling injections to patients, was a heavy-drinker with a passion for drugs. We hear from the doctor that Grigg-Booth's team lined up as an expert witness in her defence. He was never to be called; Nurse Grigg-Booth killed herself.

programme.title: Under Arrest
programme.desc: Combatants in a domestic dispute are pepper-sprayed. Police investigate a suspected bomb in a phone booth and a pair of juvenile drug mules.

programme.title: Under Arrest
programme.desc: A woman calls the police when her intoxicated son tries to strangle her. An alley filled with drug paraphernalia is center stage for a police sting.

programme.title: Crimes That Made History
programme.desc: 1978 Guyana: Reverend Jim Jones holds an apocalyptic mass. Its outcome was the sacrifice of 918 members of the Peoples Temple - an American cult founded in the middle of the 1950s. The entire world was horrified by the journalists' accounts and the images from Jonestown. This tragedy haunted the hopes of small communities and alternative spiritualities in the 70s.
programme.sub-title: The Jonestown Massacre: An American Apocalypse (1978)

programme.title: Crimes That Made History
programme.desc: On 31 August 1997, Princess Diana died alongside her companion, Dodi Al-Fayed, in a car crash in Paris, whilst being pursued by paparazzi. Her untimely death prompted an outpouring of grief in Britain and elsewhere in the world, and made her a symbol of the excesses of media intrusion, that was ironically echoed in the coverage of her funeral, broadcast live around the globe.

programme.title: Killer Mysteries
programme.desc: When a series of women are murdered in Baton Rouge, police begin DNA testing the city's population.
programme.sub-title: Derrick Todd Lee - the Baton Rouge Serial Killer

programme.title: Killer Mysteries
programme.desc: Over 20 years four-dozen women are murdered in Washington state.

programme.title: Deadly Standoffs
programme.desc: Randy and Vicki Weaver were involved in an 11-day siege after retreating to the mountainside of Ruby Ridge; re-examining the deadly 1992 standoff which left two dead.

programme.title: Forensics
programme.desc: Police are called when an abandoned car is found in Hamilton. The owner, a young mother, Carmen Thomas, hasn't been seen for days and her ex-partner, Brad Callaghan is concerned for her safety.

programme.title: Bloodline Detectives hosted by Nancy Grace
programme.desc: In 1979, 16-year-old Kim Bryant disappears from outside a Dairy Queen in Las Vegas. Three weeks later, her body is found: she had been sexually assaulted and bludgeoned to death. 40 years later, genetic genealogy finally names the killer.

programme.title: Women Behind Bars
programme.desc: A female cabdriver kills a man after he accuses her of stealing from him. Then, a store clerk is killed by a woman who participated in a liquor store robbery.

programme.title: Dr. G: Medical Examiner
programme.desc: An employee is found dead in a restaurant kitchen.

programme.title: Gangsters: America's Most Evil
programme.desc: Bey is known as the Philly Intimidator, and he was a key player in the Kaboni Savage Organization.

programme.title: Casualty 24/7
programme.desc: We spend an eventful night shift with Barnsley Hospital's casualty team. The department is already busy when Paramedics rush in 74-year-old Barry who's struggling to breathe.

programme.title: True Crime Nation with Chris Hansen
programme.desc: Host Chris Hansen and our talented team of veteran crime producers bring you a closer look at the crimes affecting our nation.

programme.title: Becoming Evil: Cult of Personality
programme.desc: The Monster Within and Among Us - The Case of Jack the Ripper. The idea of a monster, a killer stalking people began in 1888 in one of London's poorest neighborhoods, Whitechapel, with the fiend known only to history as Jack the Ripper.
programme.sub-title: The Monster Within and Among Us - The Case of Jack the Ripper

programme.title: Crime Time Solvers
programme.desc: In the quaint town of Roost-Warendin, Nord, the disappearance of Odile Touche sparked a desperate search for answers.

programme.title: The Lady Killers
programme.desc: When seemingly healthy John Proctor was found dead at his home, police were stumped. But, a woman in his family was hiding a dark secret that lead to his death

programme.title: Court Martial: Soldiers Behind Bars
programme.desc: A detainee guilty of indecent misconduct fights for his freedom.

Fighting their way to the target, mile by mile, to drop their bombs, the surviving crews can only then dare to hope they might make it home again...

programme.title: Fifth Gear

programme.title: Fifth Gear

programme.desc: Among the most enduring TV sitcoms of all time, Bewitched remains beloved nearly sixty years after its debut. programme.desc: Dennis Andrew Nilsen was a Scottish serial killer and necrophile who murdered at least twelve young men and boys between 1978 and 1983 in London. Directed by Remone Jones.

programme.title: Picture Locked: Clay Tweel
programme.desc: Filmmaker Clay Tweel breaks down his documentary "Finders Keepers" which tracks an amputee's stranger-than-fiction battle to reclaim his long-lost mummified leg. Directed by Yasir Masood & James Rohan.

programme.title: The Sentence of Michael Thompson
programme.desc: In 1994, Michael Thompson was arrested for selling three pounds of cannabis and was sentenced to 42 to 60 years in prison. He is the longest serving non-violent offender in the history of Michigan and he is finally up for clemency. Directed by Kyle Thrash and Haley Elizabeth Anderson. A DOCUMENTARY+ Original.

programme.title: How To Make A Rainbow
programme.desc: The story of a young girl and her mother, observed over the course of two years, as they move together through transitions of home, identity and name. Directed by Ryan Maxey.

programme.title: Wildfire
programme.desc: Nicola is a natural winemaker living in a remote village near Crotone, where his atavistic pursuit of wine is under active siege from climate related wildfires and the prolonged dry seasons. For Nicola, and other winemakers like him, this environmental change has existential consequences; it threatens his livelihood. "Wildfire" patiently observes Nicola in this affective state of anxiety-as the wildfire grows within him-as he's forced to alter the course of his harvest in real time.

programme.title: After Skid Row
programme.desc: After Skid Row documents the journey of Barbie Carter as she navigates the transition to housed life following the brutal reality of a decade on the streets. Her unique story and compelling character help to both demystify and deeply personalize a homelessness epidemic that continues to swell across Los Angeles. Directed by Lindsey Hagen.

programme.title: We Are Oscar Mike

programme.title: Wildfire
programme.desc: Nicola is a natural winemaker living in a remote village near Crotone, where his atavistic pursuit of wine is under active siege from climate related wildfires and the prolonged dry seasons. For Nicola, and other winemakers like him, this environmental change has existential consequences; it threatens his livelihood. "Wildfire" patiently observes Nicola in this affective state of anxiety-as the wildfire grows within him-as he's forced to alter the course of his harvest in real time.

programme.title: Blue Collar Comedy Tour: The Movie
programme.desc: The all-stars of Southern comedy collaborate in this uproarious live stand-up experience. In the summer of 2002, Jeff Foxworthy, Bill Engvall, Ron White and Larry the Cable Guy barnstorm the country with their unique brand of working-class humor. This film documenting the tour captures the highlights of the comedians' hilarious acts, while also going behind the scenes to give viewers a candid look at each of these irrepressible comic personalities.

programme.title: Blue Collar Comedy Tour Rides Again
programme.desc: This sequel to "The Blue Collar Comedy Tour" serves up more down-home humor from Southern comedians Jeff Foxworthy, Larry the Cable Guy, Bill Engvall and Ron White. The live stand-up show begins with Engvall giving the lowdown on what men really want. White follows up with his usual acerbic brand of humor. Foxworthy reels the crowd back in with an amusing routine about family and relationships. Finally, Larry the Cable Guy closes the night out on a typically lewd note.

programme.title: Time Changer
programme.desc: The year is 1890 and Bible Professor Russell Carlisle has written a manuscript and is set to receive an unanimous endorsement from the board at Grace Bible Seminary. Professor Carlisle's friend and colleague, Dr. Norris Anderson dissents, raising an objection. Using a secret time machine, Anderson sends Carlisle over 100 years into the future, offering him a glimpse of where his beliefs will lead.

programme.title: A Matter of Faith
programme.desc: A Christian girl, Rachel Whitaker (Jordan Trovillion) goes off to college for her freshman year and begins to be influenced by her popular Biology professor (Harry Anderson) who teaches that evolution is the answer to the origins of life. When Rachel's father, Stephen Whitaker (Jay Pickett) senses something changing with his daughter, he begins to examine the situation and what he discovers catches him completely off guard.

programme.title: Unidentified
programme.desc: An incident occurs in a small Texas town. A man, while driving at night home on a back highway, claims to have encountered a UFO. Two reporters from a national magazine are sent to investigate; their editor wants to publish a story on the controversial subject of UFOs. Brad (Josh Adamson) thinks they're a hoax but Keith (Jonathan Aube) senses that something is out there. What follows is a quest by each man to prove the other wrong. Are UFOs real? A hoax? Is there an explanation?

programme.title: The Secrets of Jonathan Sperry
programme.desc: Best buddies Dustin (Jansen Panettiere), Albert and Mark are twelve year old boys looking forward to a summer of fun in 1970. When Dustin mows the lawn of seventy-five year old Jonathan Sperry (Gavin MacLeod), a man he has seen at church, a unique friendship develops. What happens the rest of this summer is something Dustin and his friends will never forget!

programme.title: Notorious Women of the Bible
programme.desc: The story of Eve opens with a vision of loneliness, companionship, desire and love. It tells how woman, made in the creator's image, gives up a life of ease in an idyllic setting, along with the promise of immortality, and instead chooses to pursue wisdom and intimacy with her man. We also consider how stereotypes of Eve haunt our societal view of women today.

programme.title: Notorious Women of the Bible
programme.desc: No biblical woman is more reviled than Jezebel. Her name is still synonymous with feminine evil. Jezebel's story is a rich mix of historical events, allegorical interpretation and metaphorical licence. At the climax of her long struggle to bring pagan worship to the kingdom of Israel, Queen Jezebel paid a terrible price.

programme.title: Notorious Women of the Bible
programme.desc: The book of Esther tells the story of a beautiful orphan who hides her Jewish identity, becomes Queen of Persia and saves her people from destruction. A controversial figure, Esther has been criticized for being a 'bad Jew'; flouting tradition, marrying a gentile and being vengeful and bloodthirsty. Still, with great courage, wisdom and imagination, she stops a pogrom.

programme.title: Notorious Women of the Bible
programme.desc: Samson may have been the classic biblical Israeli strong man, but he was no match for a pretty young Philistine named Delilah. We all think we know this traditional tale, but do we? Was Delilah a pawn, a Judas or a survivor? Hers is a rich, complex story of romance, betrayal and revenge that will bring down the house as we explore this legend from an entirely new perspective.

programme.title: Life Partners
programme.desc: A 29-year-old lawyer (Gillian Jacobs) and her lesbian best friend (Leighton Meester) experience a dramatic shift in their longtime bond after one enters a serious relationship.

programme.title: Ceremony
programme.desc: An obsessed young man (Michael Angarano) crashes the wedding of his older former lover (Uma Thurman) in a misguided attempt to reignite romantic sparks.

programme.title: What Just Happened?
programme.desc: During the course of an ordinary week in Hollywood, movie producer Ben must navigate his way through shark-infested waters as he struggles to complete his latest projects. A demanding studio boss demands extensive changes to a movie starring Sean Penn, while another chief won't greenlight a project unless star Bruce Willis shaves his beard. Meanwhile, Ben tries to reconcile with his wife and maintain a relationship with his young daughter.

programme.title: Flawless
programme.desc: A janitor (Michael Caine) convinces a frustrated executive (Demi Moore) to help him steal gems from their employer, the London Diamond Corp.

programme.title: Tangerine
programme.desc: After hearing that her boyfriend/pimp cheated on her while she was in jail, a transgender sex worker and her best friend set out to find him and teach him and his new lover a lesson.

programme.title: First Date
programme.desc: Conned into buying a shady '65 Chrysler, shy teen Mike's eagerly anticipated first date with the girl next door, Kelsey, implodes as he finds himself targeted by criminals, cops and a crazy cat lady. A night fueled by desire, bullets and burning rubber makes any other first date seem like a walk in the park.

programme.title: Humpday
programme.desc: Two college buddies reunite after a decade apart. Ben (Mark Duplass) is married and planning to start a family; Andrew (Joshua Leonard), a free spirit, has spent the last 10 years traveling the globe. Reigniting the rivalries of their college years, the friends agree to enter a movie in an upcoming amateur porn festival. Ben and Andrew's constant need to one-up each other results in a daring proposition: The staunchly heterosexual friends must star together in a gay adult film.

programme.title: Goon
programme.desc: Though a misfit among his brainy family members, Massachusetts bouncer Doug Glatt (Seann William Scott) has a knockout punch that lands him a spot on a minor-league Canadian hockey team.

programme.title: Skate Kitchen
programme.desc: Camille's life as a lonely suburban teenager changes dramatically when she befriends a group of girl skateboarders. As she journeys deeper into this raw New York City subculture, she begins to understand the true meaning of friendship.

programme.title: Touchy Feely
programme.desc: A dentist (Josh Pais) gains the ability to heal his patients' physical pain while his sister (Rosemarie DeWitt), a massage therapist, develops an aversion to touching and being touched.

programme.title: The Square
programme.desc: Disaster strikes when a curator hires a public relations team to build some buzz for his renowned Swedish museum.

programme.title: Lemon
programme.desc: After Isaac's blind girlfriend walks out on him, his life goes into free fall, and he directs an unhinged staging of Chekhov's "The Seagull," attends the Passover Seder from hell, and attempts to woo a new flame.

programme.title: Drinking Buddies
programme.desc: Although they're both dating other people, two co-workers (Olivia Wilde, Jake Johnson) hang out together in bars and try to ignore their mutual attraction.

programme.title: I Am Love
programme.desc: At a dinner -- during which her husband, Tancredi (Pippo Delbono), learns that he and his son Edoardo Recchi Jr. (Flavio Parenti) are about to assume control of the Edoardo Recchi Sr.'s (Gabriele Ferzetti) lucrative business -- Emma (Tilda Swinton) meets a chef named Antonio (Edoardo Gabbriellini). Antonio and Emma soon find themselves in bed together. With the family already divided over the elder Recchi's unusual plans, Emma's affair is the wild card that might divide the family for good.

programme.title: A Long Way Down
programme.desc: Four strangers who planned to jump off the same roof on New Year's Eve join together as a kind of family and give themselves six weeks to find valid reasons to live.

programme.title: Italian Studies
programme.desc: A mysterious woman wanders the streets of Manhattan in confusion, seemingly unsure of who she is. Finding herself inexplicably drawn to a charismatic teenager, she embarks on an adventure with him through the cityscape and into the unknown.

programme.title: Humboldt County
programme.desc: Aspiring doctor Peter Hadley (Jeremy Strong) gets the shock of his life when his hard-nosed father (Peter Bogdanovich) -- and medical-school professor -- fails him, invalidating his acceptance to an elite residency program. His long-standing life plan suddenly in question, the introverted Hadley stumbles through the streets of Los Angeles, until a one-night stand with singer Bogart (Fairuza Balk) lands him on an unexpected pilgrimage to Humboldt County, the marijuana capital of the West Coast.

programme.title: Special
programme.desc: Les Franken (Michael Rapaport) has a boring and undistinguished life as a parking-meter monitor until he decides to participate in an experimental drug study. He experiences some strange side effects which make him think he is developing special powers, a belief that leads him to quit his dead-end job and start a new one -- as a superhero.

programme.title: Barry Munday
programme.desc: A slacker (Patrick Wilson) inherits new responsibilities after he impregnates a stranger (Judy Greer).

programme.title: Best Night Ever
programme.desc: Four young women have a series of wild and raucous adventures during a bachelorette party in Las Vegas.

programme.title: Force majeure
programme.desc: A man's selfish reaction to the danger posed by an avalanche causes cracks in his marriage and relationships with his children.

programme.title: Person to Person
programme.desc: During a single day in New York City, different characters grapple with the mundane, the unexpected, and the larger questions permeating their lives.

programme.title: Results
programme.desc: Personal trainers (Guy Pearce, Cobie Smulders) are charged with whipping a newly wealthy and highly unmotivated slob (Kevin Corrigan) into shape.

programme.title: Take This Waltz
programme.desc: A young woman (Michelle Williams) is torn between the husband (Seth Rogen) that she loves and a new man (Luke Kirby) in her life, whom she's unable to ignore.

programme.title: How I Live Now
programme.desc: As conflict in Europe escalates, an American teen (Saoirse Ronan) fights to survive in the English countryside.

programme.title: The Good Heart
programme.desc: Homeless and saved from almost certain death by a hospital staff, Lucas (Paul Dano) has nowhere to turn. The hospital staffers, though, are so taken with his kindness and generosity that they take up a collection to give him a fresh start. But when he's discharged, Lucas meets some fellow homeless people and gives away all the money he's just received. His roommate at the hospital, Jacques (Brian Cox), is also affected by the young man, and offers him a job at his bar.

programme.title: Experimenter
programme.desc: In 1961, social psychologist Stanley Milgram (Peter Sarsgaard) conducts controversial experiments designed to measure conformity, conscience and free will.

programme.title: Color Me Kubrick: A True...ish Story
programme.desc: The story of a man posing as director Stanley Kubrick during the production of "Eyes Wide Shut" appears to be true.

programme.title: Gordon Ramsay's Road Trip
programme.desc: Gordon, Gino and Fred start their road trip in Gino's homeland of Italy, where Gino needs help to pull off an event that is close to his heart. Gino collects Gordon and Fred in a campervan to begin a road trip they won't be forgetting in a hurry.

programme.title: Gordon Ramsay's Road Trip
programme.desc: Gordon, Gino and Fred travel to France, where Fred has been asked to co-host an Oyster Festival in the beautiful Arcachon Bay, in just four days' time. Reunited with their campervan, Fred nominates himself as the driver in his homeland.

programme.title: Gordon Ramsay's Road Trip
programme.desc: The trio heads to Scotland as Gordon prepares to cook a feast for the chief of Clan Ramsay and his friends. Gordon shows the others how to dress like real Scotsmen as they go in search of Scottish beef, hunt for scallops and play some Highland Games.

programme.title: Gordon Ramsay's Road Trip
programme.desc: Gordon, Gino and Fred travel to Greece to immerse themselves in the culinary traditions. The taste buddies go island-hopping, keen to learn more about the Mediterranean diet and how the country has one of the healthiest populations in the world.
programme.sub-title: Mamma Mia! Off We Go Again

programme.title: Gordon Ramsay's Road Trip
programme.desc: The boys are in the Greek capital Athens in a vintage VW campervan. This is where high-concept cuisine originated & is still being re-invented, in a city known as the birth place of democracy and the cradle of western civilisation.
programme.sub-title: Go Greek! Clash of the Titans

programme.title: Gordon Ramsay's Road Trip
programme.desc: On a mission to taste the worlds best breakfast, the three big egos Gordon, Gino and Fred are venturing out of their comfort zones crossing over the USA boarder into Mexico. They hope to stay out of trouble as they drive their bad boy transporter.

programme.title: Gordon Ramsay's Road Trip
programme.desc: Gordon wants to show Fred & Gino that the food and fresh produce are off the charts! In Las Vegas they indulge in one of the most expensive beef burgers. After a night at the casino they're on the road again to experience the real wild west.

programme.title: Death of Bruce Lee
programme.desc: Grandmaster Ron Van Clef teams up with Hong Kong's best martial artists to go after Bruce Lee's killers!

programme.title: Black Belt Fury
programme.desc: An enterprising Japanese (Han Ying Chieh The Big Boss) wants to take over some land owned by a Chinese mountain tribe so that he can exploit its natural resources. One of the leaders of the tribe, Ta Lu Ka (Wen Chiang Long) a martial arts expert is there to fend of the Japanese for his tribe.

programme.title: Ninja Demon's Massacre
programme.desc: Police are hot on the heels of ninjas involved in international espionage and that's got ninja gang leader Willie worried. When the police try to trick him, Willie reaches his boiling point.

programme.title: Furious Ultimatum
programme.desc: Twin Dragon Town has for generations been a leading training camp for Shaolin martial arts, but with Tiger Yeung too old to put up a fight, the town has fallen prey to gangs smuggling opium and guns. It is up to an outstanding student, Jaguar, to restore peace to the town by taking on the might of Bear Tiu. The brave never die.

programme.title: Young Hero of Shaolin
programme.desc: Young Hero of Shaolin is about legendary martial artist, Fong Sai Yuk. From an early age, Fong is raised to study martial arts, and trained by his martial artist mother before entering Shaolin Temple. Fong becomes invulnerable.

programme.title: 52 Masters
programme.desc: Will studies under Sensei Marques McCammon.
programme.sub-title: 52 Masters: KOBAYASHI SHORIN-RYU with Marques McCammon

programme.title: Dragon Bruce Lee Part 2
programme.desc: Dragon Lee leads a group of fighting patriots seeking liberty from the Japanese rule.... Watch Dragon Lee fighting Bolo, it's a classic!

programme.title: Wandering Monk
programme.desc: After a number of deathly mishaps, Monk Lu bravely rescues the bewildered young orphan Cheng, and teaches him the essence of martial arts. The two roam the countryside seeking the murderers of Cheng's father...

programme.title: Rivals of the Silver Fox
programme.desc: Chao-Kien (Casanova Wong), The Invisible Thief, in a desperate quest to avenge his wife's death steals a sword from the master of Devil Valley Lodge . To survive the final life-and-death battle for justice, he trains hard under the instruction of an old kung fu master. He must pass the test of the deadly gates of gold; wood, water, fire and earth.

programme.title: Ninja Knight 3: Heaven's Hell
programme.desc: After serving five years in prison for the murder of gang leader Donald's brother, Alfred, a fisherman by trade, finds that not only has his fiancée married into the mob but Donald is determined to ruin his life completely. A vendetta of mindless violence, which can only end in violent bloodshed.

programme.title: The Ninja Showdown
programme.desc: A poor, young fighter Tony witnesses the injustices caused by the Purple Ninjas and vows to train to become as skilled as them to one day defeat them in battle. Help is at hand from Ninja Gordon, who gives him the necessary skills since he himself is on a mission to eliminate the Purple Ninjas. Will both fighters get what they have lost and cut off the evil ninjas purple heads?

programme.title: Dragon Bruce Lee Part 2
programme.desc: Dragon Lee leads a group of fighting patriots seeking liberty from the Japanese rule.... Watch Dragon Lee fighting Bolo, it's a classic!

programme.title: Blade Of Doom
programme.desc: A roving swordsman known as Snowy White has in his possession the much sort after 13 Moon Sword. Anyone who manages to defeat him in combat may own the sword and take a high position in the martial world.

programme.title: Dance of Death
programme.desc: Kung fu girl, Angela Mao tricks two equally matched kung fu masters who duel every five years into teaching her both of their styles so she can take revenge against a vicious gang that killed her friends. The teachers stand by during her fights and count the number of moves that she uses to defeat her enemies so they can prove which of them is superior. This is one of the best choreographed Angela Mao movies, and is recommended for viewing by all Angela Mao fans.

programme.title: Rivals of the Silver Fox
programme.desc: Chao-Kien (Casanova Wong), The Invisible Thief, in a desperate quest to avenge his wife's death steals a sword from the master of Devil Valley Lodge . To survive the final life-and-death battle for justice, he trains hard under the instruction of an old kung fu master. He must pass the test of the deadly gates of gold; wood, water, fire and earth.

programme.title: Swift Shaolin Boxer
programme.desc: Angela Mao rips through her enemies! Fierce females Angela Mao and Judy Lee search and seize the Five Phoenix's Night-Shining Pearl from the wicked bandits of the Black Wind Fortress. Tieh Ying-Hung, as the leader of the woman's gang, vows to overthrow the fortress in order to restore law and order. Can she conquer the fortress and its massive army of kung fu masters and death defying traps? Top notch action from Hwang Kwo Chu the man who brought you Method man.

programme.title: The Furious Avenger
programme.desc: During the war of resistance against invading foreign powers, Wu is captured and most of his family members are brutally murdered. Wu swears to seek revenge and cannot be persuaded otherwise, even by his new love, who begs him to forgive.

programme.title: Wandering Monk
programme.desc: After a number of deathly mishaps, Monk Lu bravely rescues the bewildered young orphan Cheng, and teaches him the essence of martial arts. The two roam the countryside seeking the murderers of Cheng's father...

programme.title: Revengeful Swordswoman
programme.desc: Hsiang Ying (Chia Ling), the daughter of a slain General, is out to avenge his death by taking on his killers.

programme.title: Blind Swordswoman
programme.desc: Two blind swords women come to the aid of a swordsman tracking down a ruthless martial arts master.

programme.title: 10 Tigers of Shaolin
programme.desc: The Famed Ten Tigers of Kwangtung, one woman and nine men, defeat a local warlord who's exploiting the villagers.

programme.title: Battles with Red Boy
programme.desc: Shaw Brothers starlet Tien stars as the mythical deity Red Boy. He is sent by the gods to do battle with the monkey King who is up to more magical mischief than is good for him.

programme.title: Deadly Silver Angels
programme.desc: Two groups of knife-wielding and kicking women in bikinis join forces to kill a gang boss responsible for killing their fathers. But they're not very effective. After three attacks on the culprit, the worst damage he suffered was having his ankle run over by a motorbike. A closer co-operation with a casino boss may help.

programme.title: Cinema of Vengeance
programme.desc: "Cinema of Vengeance" is an in-depth documentary of the Hong Kong film action industry. Covering broad eras from the early black & white Chinese adventure pictures, to the first real kung fu films:, the golden days of the Shaw Bros. and Golden Harvest studios, the heyday of Bruce Lee, the gangster-influenced era, and finishing out on the time of John Woo's growing international appeal.

programme.title: 18 Shaolin Disciples
programme.desc: Chuen Chan spares the life of the evil Miao Yi Tao (Chang Yi) in a duel, and Miao swears he'll regret it! Some years later, Chen Tai (Man Kong Lung) and Shuan Ching (Hsu Feng) leave home, with the task of escorting a special shipment to the capital. The cocky young Chen Tai disgraces a group of bandits, who happen to work for Miao. Miao investigates and suspects Miao's father has information about the whereabouts of Chuen Chan, also known as The Ghost Killer.

programme.title: Lost Kung Fu Secrets
programme.desc: When an evil warlord tries to control the masses by using Christianity as a cover for his secret agenda, an earnest martial arts master (David Chiang) vows to expose the warlord's ultimate, deadly goal - to assassinate the Emperor. This film is filled to the brim with thrilling fights.

programme.title: Twins Of Kung Fu
programme.desc: Two identical twins, the younger one, a Disciple of Shaolin who's crafty tricks make up for his poor kung fu, and the elder, a vicious bandit with tremendous kung fu skills, cause havoc when they mix their identities to fool the Shaolin monks and a ruthless robber, who are both keen to catch the twins for different reasons.

programme.title: Wing Chun
programme.desc: Wing Chun has seen explosive growth, fueled by a blockbuster movie and a legion of new followers who regard it as the most effective fighting art there is. "We have seen heat waves before and not just because of Bruce Lee" says Ip Ching, son of Grandmaster Ip Man. Experience Wing Chun in its most authentic setting as we take you on a guided tour of many of Hong Kong's top schools. Although there is only one Wing Chun it has evolved into many styles...
